desc: classification: the distance of the symbols is reversed (next - c)
old: int d = c - next; // symbols are below 2^30: no overflow
new: int d = next - c; // symbols are below 2^30: no overflow

desc: classification: equal symbols inherit the opposite type
counting stores presence instead of a count
SetBucketTails leaves the bucket of the largest symbol stale (claim: never used, the largest symbol is always L-type)
round 1 placement starts from the symbol of position n - 2 (reads index -1 for n = 1)
CompactSortedLms: the clamp of an empty slot is dropped (reads packed[-1] for p = -1)
old: int pc = p & -positive; // a valid position even for an empty slot
new: int pc = p; // a valid position even for an empty slot

desc: reduced problem: the LMS positions in text order are written one slot lower (spare slot: claimed equivalent because m <= (n - 1) / 2)
old:
int tailBase = n + 1 - m;
        int idx = m;
new:
int tailBase = n - m;
        int idx = m;

desc: representation choice: packed bytes also for 128 symbols (127 << 1 | 1 = 255 still fits: claimed equivalent)
translation of the reduced ranks reads the tail one entry too high
old: for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sa[i] = sa[tailBase + sa[i]];
new: for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sa[i] = sa[tailBase + sa[i] + 1];

desc: round 2 placement: the bucket cursor is not stored back
old:
sa[slot] = p; // the target index is >= r, so no unread LMS entry is overwritten
            bkt[c] = slot;
new: sa[slot] = p; // the target index is >= r, so no unread LMS entry is overwritten

desc: stage 1 sorts with the heads of the buckets in the S pass (tails not re-set)

old: Sais<IntPtrText, TProbe>(new IntPtrText(s1, m), m, names, sa1, arena, probe, trace, level + 1);
new: Sais<IntPtrText, TProbe>(new IntPtrText(s1, m), m, m, sa1, arena, probe, trace, level + 1);
